resources.string: The default address works for most keys. If Model Studio gave your workspace its own address, use wss://<workspace ID>.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/api-ws/v1/inference.

A voice call needs an Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian) API key. Add Bailian under Settings → Manage Providers (OpenAI compatible, address dashscope.aliyuncs.com), turn on real-time speech recognition and synthesis in the Model Studio console, then call again.
A voice call needs the microphone.
The microphone could not be opened. Another app may be using it.
Model Studio refused the key (HTTP %1$d). Check the key, and that speech recognition and synthesis are turned on for it.
No reply came back. Check the chat model.

Used for voice input, read-aloud and the quick test. A speech model typed in by hand can be picked once its name says what it does (qwen3-asr-flash, fun-asr-realtime, cosyvoice-v3-flash, qwen3-tts-flash). The voice call keeps its own Model Studio models in its settings.
